description: DML statements report their affected-row count Snowflake-style: a single-row result whose column is number of rows inserted / updated / deleted (MERGE one column per action), surfaced as the statement's update count; DDL reports zero and a no-match UPDATE reports zero. Converted 1:1 from dml/AffectedRowCountTest (now retired).
